title: Pusheen Box is great... sometimes
text: I been following amazing pusheen boxes that worth 50$ completely, every season looks like the items get cheaper, probably inflation, Fall 2020 box was the worst of all the boxes, Pusheen guys, if you think you need more money to get better quality products ask for it, my box arrived almost 3 weeks later, so don't believe in those arrival dates, I got spoiled of my pusheen items because of delay, so avoid your youtube channels in those dates, since I need this lovely and misunderstood  fluffy cat (blue box?????) I will buy again with the hope that the design team doesn't get lazy this time, Won't somebody please think of the children :'(
label: neutral
